definitions.gloss: agency; dealer; authorized agent; representative office
definitions.explanation: A business that acts on behalf of another company — selling products, providing services, or handling transactions as an authorized representative.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}{代理店|だいりてん}で{航空|こうくう}{券|けん}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I booked a plane ticket at a travel agency.

examples.japanese: この{車|くるま}の{正規|せいき}{代理店|だいりてん}はどこですか。
examples.english: Where is the authorized dealer for this car?

examples.japanese: {広告|こうこく}{代理店|だいりてん}に{新|あたら}しいキャンペーンの{企画|きかく}を{依頼|いらい}した。
examples.english: We asked the advertising agency to plan a new campaign.

notes:
A compound of {代理|だいり} (proxy, agent) + {店|てん} (shop, business). Very common in business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旅行|りょこう}{代理店|だいりてん}: travel agency
- {広告|こうこく}{代理店|だいりてん}: advertising agency
- {保険|ほけん}{代理店|だいりてん}: insurance agency
- {正規|せいき}{代理店|だいりてん}: authorized dealer
- {販売|はんばい}{代理店|だいりてん}: sales agent/distributor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {代理人|だいりにん}: agent (a person, not a business)
- {販売店|はんばいてん}: retail shop (sells directly, may not be an agent)
- {仲介|ちゅうかい}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}: broker, intermediary
